WITH live AS (
  SELECT id, expires_at
  FROM demo_sessions
  WHERE email = 'verify-session-test@x.test' AND expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), seeded AS (
  INSERT INTO demo_sessions (email, expires_at)
  SELECT 'verify-session-test@x.test', now() + interval '2 hours'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live)
  RETURNING id, expires_at
)
SELECT id::text AS session_id,
       floor(extract(epoch FROM expires_at) * 1000)::bigint AS expires_ms
FROM live
UNION ALL
SELECT id::text, floor(extract(epoch FROM expires_at) * 1000)::bigint
FROM seeded
